resources.string: Picture and sound for live channels. Changes apply to the next channel you open.
Follows the setting in Nuvio\'s player settings, now: %1$s
Switches the TV to the channel\'s frame rate once it is playing.
Also switches the TV to the channel\'s resolution while frame rate matching is on.
Sends Dolby Digital and Dolby Digital Plus sound to your receiver or soundbar as set in Nuvio\'s audio settings.
Uses Nuvio\'s passthrough, AC-3 transcoding and downmix settings. Multiview and the corner picture always decode in the app.
Always sends decoded sound. Try this if a channel has no sound through your receiver.

Lets the TV box keep picture and sound in sync in hardware. Main picture only; not used in multiview, with Prefer app decoder or when 4K and HDR in the corner picture is off. Volume boost and the surround lift are off while it is in use.
Picks the audio track with the most channels in the same language. Stereo plays when a channel has no surround track.
Picks this language when a channel has more than one audio track.
Which decoder plays live sound. Video keeps using the TV box\'s decoder.
The TV box\'s decoder, with the app\'s decoder for formats it cannot play.
Decodes sound in the app first, including formats your receiver could take as passthrough. Try this if a channel crackles or has no sound.
